Catch the drift

A synthetic card-transaction stream scored by stream-fraud. Somewhere in each stream the fraud pattern changes. Watch the risk score, guess where the change happens, then see when the PSI, KS and Page-Hinkley drift detectors actually alarmed - and how long they took.

Press Play. Click "I see drift!" at the first transaction where you think the fraud pattern changed.

Across all 20 seeds

All transactions are synthetic, generated by stream_fraud.stream (seed shown above). The drift lands at the same hidden transaction in every seed; revealing shows where. Reference = first 400 scores, current window = 400. The KS monitor is experimental: its alpha is the level of a single test, not the monitor's false-alarm rate, because tests repeat on overlapping, autocorrelated windows. The Page-Hinkley monitor is experimental too: its threshold trades detection delay against false alarms and was tuned on these same 20 seeds. This is a teaching demo, not production detection. Series are computed by scripts/build_drift_demo.py from the real replay code; nothing is hand-drawn.
